summary.text: Case Brittain is a Republican attorney and member of the South Carolina House of Representatives from District 107, in office since November 9, 2020, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Case Brittain was born in Columbia, South Carolina.
Brittain earned a B.S. from Wofford College in 2002 and a J.D. from Charleston School of Law in 2007, and his career experience includes work as an attorney.
Brittain is assigned to the House Judiciary Committee and the House Rules Committee for 2025-2026.
In 2021-2022 he served on the House Rules Committee and the Education and Public Works Committee.
